_comment: Public EXAMPLE manifest for the EngramHalo image recipe. This describes source pins and base-image digests that were read/verified via public git hosting and container registry APIs on the date below. It is NOT a record of an actual build: no image has been built from scripts/engramhalo/Dockerfile yet. Do not treat 'image_digest' as real; it is intentionally a placeholder because no build has happened.

packaging_patches_source.note: Same commit hash as the EngramHalo.cpp source pin; halo-box/strix-llama.cpp shares commit history with Aristo94/EngramHalo.cpp (fork relationship), this was confirmed by fetching the commit object from both repos, not assumed from the matching hash alone.

known_issue_qwen38_patch.summary: docs/strix-halo/llama-cpp-qwen38-per-buffer-mmap.patch (sha256 971d428de98ecdf59941946bb391c257e82501ce98b7c71cc1f34803181fe133) fails both `git apply --check` and `git apply --reverse --check` against the pinned EngramHalo.cpp commit, verified with a real isolated clone + patch attempt (not assumed from an error message alone). Root cause: the pinned commit already carries an independently-added upstream TENSOR_READ_LAZY (lazy tensor read) feature in src/llama-model-loader.cpp that generalized the exact `if (use_mmap)` gate this patch's third hunk rewrites; the other two hunks (llama-model-loader.h, llama-model.cpp) still apply with a pure line-number offset, only the third hunk conflicts semantically.
known_issue_qwen38_patch.override_status: experimental compatibility rebase; reviewed against pinned source; application and structural tests pass (git apply --check, no fuzz, at this exact pinned commit + first patch already applied); NOT yet compiled or runtime validated; compiling it is the required next step before model deployment, not an unfinished external human-review gate

builder.verified_via: anonymous GET https://registry.fedoraproject.org/v2/fedora/manifests/44 (Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json), Docker-Content-Digest response header; no auth token published or persisted

runtime.verified_via: anonymous GET https://registry.fedoraproject.org/v2/fedora-minimal/manifests/44 (Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json), Docker-Content-Digest response header; no auth token published or persisted

rocm.reproducibility_limitation: This repo is a live, mutable dnf/yum repository. Pinning the source commit and base image digests above does NOT pin the exact ROCm package NEVRA installed at build time; re-running the build on a different day can resolve different package versions/builds even though gpgcheck=1 continues to validate signatures against the existing repo.amd.com key. Full bit-reproducibility would require pinning and mirroring exact package files separately, which is out of scope for this pass.

build_jobs_cap.note: Conservative fixed worker cap validated by the Dockerfile at build time (not $(nproc) and not unbounded), matching the resource-constrained build host scope for this recipe.

follow_up_after_real_build: Replace image_digest/built_at with the actual sha256 produced by `docker build`/`podman build`.
Reference the image ONLY by that final sha256 digest in scripts/engramhalo/config.example.json-style configs and in Lemonade rocm_bin wiring; never by a mutable tag.
Re-verify the base image digests above at build time since registry content can be re-tagged; the digests here are a point-in-time read, not a permanent guarantee.
